tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: Discover iPhones, iPads, and iOS simulators with readiness and tool availability. Use the returned device ID with select_device to set this client's target.

tools.name: start_simulator
tools.description: Boot an existing iOS simulator by ID, or create one from a device type and installed iOS runtime. Returns the booted device ID and whether it was created.

tools.name: shut_down_simulator
tools.description: Shut down a selected simulator while keeping its installed apps and files. A successful result confirms the simulator stopped.

tools.name: select_device
tools.description: Set this client's target to a device ID from list_devices. Selection returns readiness and leaves the device in its current power state.

tools.name: get_device_info
tools.description: Read the selected device's OS, readiness, and supported operations. Use its capability details to choose an input or capture method.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the selected device screen without saving an artifact. The returned image and observation ID give you the current coordinates for input.

tools.name: save_screenshot
tools.description: Save an image of the selected device to TapMesh or an approved folder. Returns the finalized artifact reference after owner approval.

tools.name: start_recording
tools.description: Start a bounded video recording on a device that supports screen recording. Get owner approval and keep the returned recording ID for stop_recording.

tools.name: stop_recording
tools.description: Finalize a recording from this session using its recording ID. The result includes saved segments and reports any gaps or partial files.

tools.name: get_foreground_app
tools.description: Identify the app currently in front on the selected device. The result reports unknown if the backend cannot observe it.

tools.name: list_elements
tools.description: Inspect the selected device using accessibility or screen text recognition. The response provides a snapshot ID and element references for later input.

tools.name: tap
tools.description: Tap one point or element on the selected device. Use a current take_screenshot observation for coordinates or a list_elements snapshot for a reference.

tools.name: tap_text
tools.description: Find unique visible text from a fresh inspection and tap it. Choose a more specific match or an occurrence if the text appears more than once.

tools.name: double_tap
tools.description: Send two taps to one target with a configurable interval. Obtain coordinates from take_screenshot or an element reference from list_elements.

tools.name: long_press
tools.description: Hold and release a touch at one target for the requested duration. Anchor the target to take_screenshot or list_elements before sending it.

tools.name: swipe
tools.description: Move one touch from start to end over a specified duration. Both endpoints must come from the same take_screenshot or list_elements observation.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll in one direction by a bounded distance. For a specific container, call list_elements first and pass its reference and snapshot ID.

tools.name: scroll_to
tools.description: Inspect and scroll in bounded steps until matching text or an element comes into view. Supply one text match or element selector and a direction.

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Press, hold, then move and release a touch between two points. Obtain both endpoints from the same take_screenshot or list_elements observation.

tools.name: pinch
tools.description: Send a two-finger scale gesture around a target on a supported device. Use take_screenshot for the center coordinates or list_elements for a reference.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Insert text at the focused field or at a target from take_screenshot or list_elements. Physical keyboard input needs the US layout. Clipboard paste requires approval.

tools.name: fill
tools.description: Replace text at a target from take_screenshot or list_elements, with optional submit. Check the actual field value after sending. Clipboard paste requires approval.

frame_validation.description: Compatibility declaration. Physical input never compares screen frames before sending, so both values behave the same on a physical device. text_target requires ordinary_app and no submit. Simulator supports exact only.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Send a supported key or modifier chord to the focused app on the selected device. Observe the screen afterward to check how the app handled it.

tools.name: hide_keyboard
tools.description: Ask the selected device to dismiss its on-screen keyboard using a supported input method. Check the next image to confirm the keyboard closed.

tools.name: press_button
tools.description: Send a named hardware or system button action supported by the selected device. The device may require a person to handle a protected button.

tools.name: system_gesture
tools.description: Invoke a supported system gesture, such as Home, Control Center, or the app switcher. Inspect the device afterward to confirm it opened.

tools.name: go_back
tools.description: Go back using a supported navigation element or edge gesture. The result identifies the strategy used or reports that no supported target exists.

tools.name: rotate
tools.description: Request a supported device orientation and read the effective orientation when available. Refresh the screen before using coordinates after rotation.

tools.name: set_appearance
tools.description: Set light, dark, or system appearance on a supported device. Inspect its screen if you need to confirm how the active app applied the change.

tools.name: set_accessibility
tools.description: Update supported accessibility settings on the selected device. Supply at least one option, such as Reduce Motion or a text-size category.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List apps on the selected device, with an optional query or inclusion of system apps. Use the returned bundle IDs to target later app operations.

tools.name: launch_app
tools.description: Open an installed app by its bundle ID from list_apps. Providing launch arguments or environment requires approval. Check the foreground app afterward.

tools.name: terminate_app
tools.description: Stop the installed app with the given bundle ID. Use list_apps to identify the app and read the result to see whether stopping was confirmed.

tools.name: install_app
tools.description: Install an app from an approved local file path. Obtain approval for installation or destructive confirmation if you request replacement.

tools.name: uninstall_app
tools.description: Remove the app identified by bundle ID and its device data. Confirm the correct app with list_apps and obtain destructive approval first.

tools.name: open_settings
tools.description: Open the Settings app on a supported device. Request the root screen and observe the device afterward to verify what opened.

tools.name: open_url
tools.description: Send a URL to the selected device for its default app or registered handler. Non-HTTP links need approval. Observe the device to confirm the destination.

tools.name: build_and_run
tools.description: Build an Xcode project or workspace from an approved folder and install the resulting app on the selected device. Review the stage results and build log.

tools.name: set_location
tools.description: Set the selected device's simulated location on a supported backend. Obtain sensitive-action approval before applying the device-wide override.

tools.name: clear_location
tools.description: Remove an existing simulated location override on a supported device. Use this when the location test ends to restore normal location behavior.

tools.name: get_clipboard
tools.description: Read text from the selected device's clipboard with owner approval. The clipboard may contain content synchronized through Universal Clipboard.

tools.name: set_clipboard
tools.description: Replace text in the selected device's clipboard with owner approval. The new text may sync to other nearby Apple devices.

tools.name: list_crashes
tools.description: List crash report metadata with owner approval. Filter by app or date and use a returned report ID with get_crash to retrieve it.

tools.name: get_crash
tools.description: Retrieve a crash report by its ID from list_crashes. Owner approval is required. Optional symbolication needs matching symbols in an approved location.

tools.name: download_app_container
tools.description: Archive the accessible data container for a development app. Supply its bundle ID and obtain owner approval before writing the export.

tools.name: request_human_action
tools.description: Ask the owner to complete a step on the device, such as handling a protected prompt. Provide instructions without credentials or other secrets.

tools.name: handle_alert
tools.description: Choose a specific button on an ordinary alert using a current list_elements snapshot. Ask the owner to handle protected prompts.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Observe a selected device until a supported condition is met or the timeout expires. Conditions can check visible text, an element, foreground app, or readiness.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Pause this call for a bounded duration. Returns the elapsed time and leaves device selection and device state alone.

tools.name: batch_commands
tools.description: Run up to 25 allowed commands in order on one device. The batch uses the highest approval policy among its steps and returns each outcome without rollback.

frame_validation.description: Compatibility declaration. Physical input never compares screen frames before sending, so both values behave the same on a physical device. text_target requires ordinary_app and no submit. Simulator supports exact only.
